condition: With a large initial guess x0 on an ill-conditioned system, cg's recursively updated residual drifts away from the true residual, so cg returns info=0 even though the true residual b - A@x misses the tolerance by a huge factor.
workaround: After cg returns, check the true residual norm(b - A@x) against the tolerance yourself. If it fails, restart cg with the returned x as x0, or use a small or zero initial guess.
